scope.interactionChannel: real macOS secondary click and menu selection via cliclick

setup.method: isolated copied snapshot with initialOverlay right-panel-tabs

observations.name: file row system menu
observations.detail: A real secondary click on README.md in owned PID 34114 opens the macOS system menu with Copy mention and Add to chat.

observations.name: Add to chat
observations.detail: Selecting Add to chat writes [README.md](README.md) into the real Composer after the asynchronous SelectorQuery update, enables Send, keeps both right-panel tabs visible, and leaves owned PID 34114 alive without a blank LynxView.

rejectedSamples.detail: The prior retained files mixed an older PID 34909 with the later safe SelectorQuery build. Those files were deleted and replaced; they receive no repair credit.

The first Add-to-chat implementation crossed a component-local main-thread closure and blanked the LynxView. It was replaced with background-thread SelectorQuery setValue, setSelectionRange, and focus UI methods before this retained pass.

An immediate post-click capture preceded the asynchronous SelectorQuery UI update and still showed the placeholder. A subsequent stable capture from the same owned PID proved the mention insertion; only the stable frame is retained.

closedProductLoss: Native file rows expose the Web authority's system menu actions.
Add to chat writes the canonical markdown mention into the real Composer without converting the textarea to a controlled input.
External insertion uses documented Lynx SelectorQuery UI methods and no longer blanks the LynxView.
remainingProductLoss: Question-mode Composer intentionally rejects file mention insertion, but Native has no toast surface explaining that rejection.
missingCoverage: Copy mention clipboard contents were not physically inspected.
Dark theme, nested directories, and narrow sheet layout are not retained.
classification.harnessLoss: Lynxtron 0.0.16 did not register an owned Desktop DevTool client, so no DevTool console or computed geometry is claimed. Unrelated iOS LynxExplorer/dev-server sessions were explicitly excluded.
classification.intentionalPlatformDelta: The popup uses native macOS menu material instead of Web popup pixels.

validation.productionBuild: pass with existing unsupported-CSS and Effect import.meta warnings
